sites.name: Patriot battery, Isa Air Base
sites.source: Bahrain is a Patriot operator (public reporting); placement at Isa Air Base is a scenario assumption
sites.notes: 160 km is the Auftragstaktik SYSTEM_RANGES figure for MIM-104 Patriot.

platform.note: No platform DB record carries MIM-104 Patriot; the OSINT range is used as published

sites.name: 3rd Khordad battery, Qeshm
sites.source: 3rd Khordad is an Iranian-built medium-range SAM publicly shown by Iranian state media (about 75 km); placement on Qeshm is a scenario assumption
sites.notes: Notional coverage of the strait's central approaches from Qeshm Island. Range is the Iranian-stated figure.

citations.label: CSIS Missile Defense Project: Iranian air defense

platform.note: No platform DB record carries 3rd Khordad; the OSINT range is used as published

sites.name: S-300PMU-2 battery, Bandar Abbas
sites.source: Iran is a documented S-300PMU-2 operator (Auftragstaktik record ir-s300-isfahan, CSIS Missile Threat); placement at Bandar Abbas is a scenario assumption
sites.notes: Notional placement at the IRIAF fighter base that defends the strait's northern shore. 200 km is the public maximum range of the 48N6E2 missile.

platform.note: No platform DB record carries S-300PMU-2; the OSINT range is used as published

sites.name: S-300PMU-2 battery, Bushehr
sites.source: Iran is a documented S-300PMU-2 operator (CSIS Missile Threat); a battery guarding the Bushehr plant has been reported in open sources, placement here is a scenario assumption
sites.notes: Placed at the Bushehr nuclear plant. 200 km is the public maximum range of the 48N6E2 missile.

platform.note: No platform DB record carries S-300PMU-2; the OSINT range is used as published

sites.name: Tor-M1 point defence, Bushehr
sites.source: Iran took delivery of 29 Tor-M1 systems from Russia in 2007 (Wikipedia: Tor missile system); use for point defence of the Bushehr plant is reported, placement is a scenario assumption
sites.notes: Short-range point defence, 12 km maximum engagement range.

platform.note: No platform DB record carries Tor-M1; the OSINT range is used as published

sites.name: Patriot battery, Dhahran
sites.source: Saudi Arabia is a Patriot operator (Auftragstaktik record sa-patriot-riyadh); Dhahran has been defended by Patriot since 1991, placement is anchored to King Abdulaziz Air Base
sites.notes: 160 km is the Auftragstaktik SYSTEM_RANGES figure for MIM-104 Patriot.

platform.note: No platform DB record carries MIM-104 Patriot; the OSINT range is used as published

sites.name: Patriot battery, Al Dhafra
sites.source: Patriot batteries have been deployed at Al Dhafra Air Base (public reporting); placement is anchored to the base
sites.notes: 160 km is the Auftragstaktik SYSTEM_RANGES figure for MIM-104 Patriot.

platform.note: No platform DB record carries MIM-104 Patriot; the OSINT range is used as published

sites.name: Patriot battery, Al Udeid
sites.source: Patriot batteries defend Al Udeid Air Base (US and Qatari operation, public reporting); placement is anchored to the base
sites.notes: 160 km is the Auftragstaktik SYSTEM_RANGES figure for MIM-104 Patriot.

platform.note: No platform DB record carries MIM-104 Patriot; the OSINT range is used as published

sites.name: THAAD battery, Al Dhafra
sites.source: The UAE operates THAAD and US THAAD batteries deployed to the UAE (public reporting); placement is anchored to Al Dhafra
sites.notes: Exo-/endo-atmospheric ballistic missile defence, about 200 km engagement range (Lockheed Martin / MDA public figure). Shares the Al Dhafra anchor with the Patriot battery; the panel fans out co-located sites.

platform.note: No platform DB record carries THAAD; the OSINT range is used as published

sites.name: Barakah Nuclear Power Plant
sites.notes: 4 APR-1400 reactors (Korean design). First nuclear plant in the Arab world. All 4 units operational as of 2024.

platform.note: Not a platform: exclusion radius from the source record

sites.name: Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant
sites.notes: Iran's only power-producing reactor. 1000MW VVER-1000, Russian-built. IAEA safeguarded. Unit 2 under construction.

platform.note: Not a platform: exclusion radius from the source record

sites.name: AN/TPY-2 X-band radar, Qatar
sites.source: A forward-based AN/TPY-2 radar in Qatar is publicly reported (US missile defence cooperation); placement is anchored to Al Udeid, the range is the public figure for the forward-based mode
sites.notes: Ring drawn only when selected (range exceeds the map's useful ring size).

platform.note: No platform DB record carries AN/TPY-2; the OSINT range is used as published
